title: Maximum Number of Tasks You Can Assign
goal: Assign the largest number of tasks using one optional strength pill per worker.
strategy: Binary search the count using easiest tasks and strongest workers. Process those workers from weakest upward: use an easy task without a pill when possible, otherwise spend a pill on the hardest currently reachable task.

edgeCases: No pills means only natural worker strength matters
One large boost should cover the hardest reachable task
Zero boost cannot change a failed assignment
